Vendored files come from the upstream `docs/` directory, unmodified:
  docs/binjgb.js    13640 bytes   Emscripten glue, exposes the global factory Binjgb()
  docs/binjgb.wasm  88269 bytes   the emulator core

Upstream commit: c60e138da5a795ebb55e56b11b7e90024e41112c
Fetched:         2026-08-12

To update, re-download both files from
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/binji/binjgb/main/docs/
and record the new commit here. Do not edit them by hand — js/core-loader.js
is written so that no patching of the glue is ever required.
